items.quote: And he stayed yet other seven days; and again he sent forth the dove out of the ark
items.claim: After a seven-day interval, Noah sent the dove from the ark

items.quote: And the dove came in to him in the evening; and, lo, in her mouth was an olive leaf pluckt off: so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth
items.claim: The dove's return in the evening bearing an olive leaf was the mechanism by which Noah determined the floodwaters had receded
